text: Chapter 15: Coenubia's Awakening@Visions of a Distant Past
■Next Mission\nMove from Izolara Underground Passage to\nGrazen Forecourt to start.
The ground beyond the Izolara Underground Passage is marked\nwith traces of battle.\nHead to Grazen Tower to find out what happened here!
The door to Grazen Tower is also marked with traces of\nbattle. Fortunately, it's not locked. Let's keep moving and\nfind out what happened at Grazen Tower!
More and more Lixi phantoms are gathering, forming a massive\nCoenubia!\nAnono is in danger! Let's defeat it quickly!
